overall_summary: The channel shows initial baseline views across all videos with very low sample sizes. However, 'self respect' and boundary-setting topics (like deleting chats or muting pinned conversations) slightly outperform pure sadness or overthinking hooks. Confidence is low due to minimal engagement variance and low view counts overall.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (36 views) and 'aNR94Xxn0yM' (24 views) focusing on self respect and taking action on chats performed better than passive sadness.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on moments of reclaiming self-respect rather than just suffering in silence.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or generic waiting tropes yielded lower relative engagement and views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive time-based hooks and replace them with active tactile decisions regarding phones or personal space.
